title: 4Sum
statement: Return every unique quadruplet that sums to `target`. Sort each quadruplet and sort the list of quadruplets.
hints: 4Sum is 3Sum with one extra fixed index.
Sort, skip duplicates at every fixed index, and finish with two pointers.
Reduce the target by the two fixed values before the inner scan.

approaches.name: Sort plus k-sum recursion of depth 2
approaches.explanation: Two fixed indices, then a linear two-pointer scan.

editorial: Sort the array. The outer two loops choose the first two values and skip duplicates the same way 3Sum does. The inner two pointers search for target minus those two values. The pattern generalizes to kSum: k-2 nested loops and one two-pointer base case.
